daily_report_items: Carlisle Companies' strengthened July 29 volume anomaly was classified as risk rather than a discrete opportunity or noise. The 7.78% measured-period decline and 2.70 volume z-score were material, while the after-close Q2 release showed growth alongside margin pressure, weak first-half cash conversion, leverage, and flat margin guidance. A completed full security review had already absorbed the exact alert and found only 8.6% base upside against 15.5% downside, so no duplicate wiki update or follow-up was created.

evidence.claim: The deterministic alert packet records a strengthened volume anomaly for immutable security security_9b0db3bc77914b23a307 over 2026-06-30 through 2026-07-29, with adjusted close declining from the period start to USD 334.5400085449219, a period return of -0.0777670336459768435561681599, and trigger strength increasing from 0.098151035 to 0.349626385.

Carlisle's SEC-filed Q2 release reports 8% revenue growth and 12% adjusted-EPS growth, but adjusted EBITDA margin declined 70 basis points as input and freight inflation outpaced pricing; first-half operating cash flow was USD 197 million, free cash flow was USD 130 million, and management changed the 2026 adjusted EBITDA margin outlook to flat. The filing was submitted after the July 29 regular session and therefore does not explain that session's move.

A successful priority-95 security review already evaluated this exact strengthened 2026-07-29 volume anomaly and updated the maintained Carlisle page. It classified the anomaly as material attention and risk evidence, retained a baseline-comparison-only disposition, found 15.5% downside versus 8.6% base upside, and created no strategy or idea follow-up.

The maintained page links the immutable CSL/XNYS/USD identity to the exact alert, records July 29 volume of 1,108,300 shares and a 2.70 z-score, states that the move is material but not a discrete opportunity, and records no conviction strategy because the valuation gate failed.
